mine_p16_001.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_001.text: Chen Ai asked Lin to describe her morning before asking about the failed preparation. The answer included fastening her own sleeve, carrying nothing on the clinic walk, and sleeping without waking to new pain. Improvement in those acts mattered, but it was not evidence that her former input route could safely resume. Chen repeated touch and movement comparisons, recording the findings against the earlier examinations. Lin did not recite the answer she wanted Wei to hear. The wrist still required restrictions, and the method problem belonged to another qualified assessment.

mine_cash_recovery_601.speaker: narrator
mine_cash_recovery_601.text: The Day 601 clinical appointment cost eight coppers. Lin paid it from the actual personal reserve after the work of assessment was provided. Thirty two became twenty four; the course examiner payment was a different prepaid item and did not purchase this clinical service. The existing weekly board covered the ordinary room and meals through Day 603. Chen gave the next tissue review a date, Day 642, with earlier contact for the stated warning changes. Lin held both papers without treating a future appointment as performed care or future wages as money in her purse.

mine_p16_003.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_003.text: Chen permitted a carefully defined trial of ordinary seated oral receiving, with supported posture, scheduled rests inside four hours, and an immediate stop if the stated changes appeared. It excluded handwriting, loaded grip, lifting and carrying, and any qi application. Permission for that ordinary employment did not release the stopped cultivation route. Lin asked about using the sounder hand to sign receipts. Chen said a different grip could still load the affected movement; the writer should handle the pages as already proposed. A small job was suitable because its actual demands were controlled, not because its title sounded gentle.

mine_p16_004.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_004.text: The clinical advice gave Qiao something she could actually accept. At the surface table Lin shared only the practical task and hours restrictions she had chosen to release. Qiao read them with Ren and the separately rostered writer, then amended the five half days rather than leaving the former assistant description in place. Paid carriers would handle all objects. Lin's role was to hear an authorized report, ask a source question, and speak a comparison for the writer to record. The employer accepted that reduced roster on Day 601; no full receiving shift was smuggled inside it.

mine_p16_005.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_005.text: The five accepted four hour half days were scheduled for Days 607, 614, 621, 628, and 635, four coppers after each completed turn. Rest intervals remained part of those hours. Qiao named Ren as the source contact if a comparison could not be finished within the accepted period. Nothing required Lin to stay unpaid until a disputed number became convenient. Lin agreed to the actual terms, feeling the loss of her former speed more sharply than the little wage. Ren signed the employer's work record while she gave her oral acceptance through the agreed witness.

mine_p16_006.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_006.text: Wei met her later that day at the practice court for the first of the six prepaid independent examination services. She received the practical clinical advice Lin authorized and reviewed the failed control record under the candidate's own permission. No input was admitted. Ordinary movement improvement did not validate an interrupted governing and conception bridge, and the nominal reserve was not current demonstrated usable throughput. Wei kept application stopped. The service had occurred even though it yielded continued waiting rather than a trial date. Lin had paid for a competent judgment, not a favorable answer.

mine_p16_007.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_007.text: Without input, Wei asked her to describe the sequence she had actually attempted on Day 590. Lin initially began with why she had felt hurried. Wei let her finish, then asked again about the ending she had omitted. Lin named full release, rest, and the check before resumption. The words sounded painfully simple now. Explaining the error did not execute a safe route in the body. They kept the failed measured quarter cost in the record and the new restrictions in force. The examiner would not manufacture a successful rehearsal from a clear retrospective sentence.

mine_p16_008.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_008.text: The clinic's practical movement plan and Wei's stopped method plan fit together without becoming the same authority. Lin could undertake the accepted oral job after ordinary improvement while remaining unable to make an input application. She repeated that distinction to Guan before leaving. He marked the fixture unavailable to her, so a familiar empty hour would not quietly become permission to test it alone. She disliked the visible stop mark. Guan said it was the honest condition of equipment assigned to a learner whose route had failed, not a public account of her private pain.

mine_p16_009.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_009.text: Outside the court Mu was arguing with a customer over a screen frame too warped for her accepted repair. Lin heard the last part and waited rather than supplying an opinion about wood she had not inspected. The customer wanted the new cloth to conceal the distortion. Mu offered the repaired cloth separately and named a frame worker for the remaining task. He took the cloth and left displeased. Mu sat beside Lin after her paid work ended and said a useful refusal could still lose a customer. Lin answered that she had become very good at useful refusals lately.

mine_p16_010.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_010.text: The joke relieved neither of them enough to end the conversation. Mu asked what the clinic had actually permitted, and Lin shared the narrow work arrangement. Mu was pleased about the paid writer because her own customers often assumed copying was invisible labor. They discussed the writer's four hours as an ordinary person's shift with its own end. If the disputed manifest lasted longer, the mine would need another properly assigned interval. Lin could not make her reduced job fair by letting someone else's paid role disappear beneath her accommodation. That responsibility belonged in Qiao's accepted roster.

mine_p16_011.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_011.text: Lei's separate ordinary duty assessment took place on Day 602. The employer's new support account paid the four copper fee directly after the assessment. Chen considered his viable hand, current permitted acts, and the proposed seated sorting task, not Lin's private input failure. Lei authorized the duty findings to reach Qiao and kept the rest of his clinical history private. The first turn remained Day 604, with handling exclusions and rests in its four hours. His missing fingers remained missing. The assessment permitted suitable useful work without pretending his former hand had returned.

mine_p16_012.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_012.text: At supper he described the task as sorting paper sleeve sizes without carrying the bundles or forcing a tight grip. A sound carrier would set the materials within the arranged position, and another worker would move the completed lot. Lin asked whether he liked it. Lei said he liked knowing exactly what he was being asked to do, which was a smaller answer than liking everything. They ate Han's beans and did not turn the two clinical plans into a competition. The room could hold different recoveries, different injuries, and the fact that both still wanted wages.

mine_p16_013.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_013.text: Before Lei's first turn on Day 604, they checked the separate support dates. The current paid board period had begun on Day 598; another payment was due Day 605. Lin corrected herself when reading them aloud. His first work turn belonged to Day 604, not the next board receipt. One could be performed while the other was still pending. Lei laughed at her seriousness, then asked her to keep the dates separate when speaking about his arrangement again.

mine_p16_014.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_014.text: Lin paid her own four copper board charge on Day 604, before any reduced wage had been earned. Twenty four became twenty, covering the room and ordinary meals through Day 610. She could make that payment because the actual saved reserve existed; the proposed Day 607 wage was not yet available. Han accepted the coins and handed her the settled receipt. The act was less dramatic than a mine accident and more immediate than a future certificate. She would sleep and eat during the week in which the first narrow work turn might succeed or fail.

mine_p16_015.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_015.text: Lei completed his first four hour seated sorting turn that afternoon under the accepted ordinary restrictions. The carrier brought and removed the bundles, and the scheduled rests stayed within the paid period. When a sleeve lodged beneath a box, Lei sent for the assigned handler rather than twisting his viable hand to rescue the rhythm. He received four coppers after the turn was finished. The employer's support account retained the unspent later wages and board money under its own custody. Lin was glad for him without moving his received pay into her private medical reserve.

mine_p16_016.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_016.text: On Day 605 Qiao checked the oral table before Lin's first shift. The stools were firm, the writer's pages lay where he could use them, and a clear sound carrier contact was posted for every load. The arrangements looked almost excessive until a supplier asked where he should set a heavy plate. Qiao directed him to the receiving stand, away from Lin's place. A careful job description had met its first ordinary temptation before she began work. Lin watched the plate settle under the proper handler and felt how easily the former task might otherwise have returned.

mine_p16_017.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_017.text: The writer was named He Song. He did not need Lin's private injury account to understand his paid role. Ren showed him which spoken comparison required a source citation and which words should remain an unresolved question. He Song asked whether he could improve Lin's phrasing if she stumbled. Ren said he could ask for clarification, but not silently replace a careful limit with a more confident statement. Lin welcomed the answer. She was learning to work through another person's writing without allowing that person to become a decorative hand attached to her opinions.

mine_p16_018.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_018.text: The first accepted oral turn began on Day 607. A carrier placed the authorized condition sheet with He Song, and Lin heard Ren's report from the sound bench. One crate number was rubbed at its last digit. She asked the sender to identify the source rather than completing it from the neighboring row. The paid writer recorded the unanswered question. The carrier returned the physical plate to the proper stand. Lin stayed seated and supported, speaking within the defined task. Her old desire to reach across and point at the object remained an urge, not an authorized action.

mine_p16_019.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_019.text: The supplier complained that an oral checker who could not lift a plate was slowing the whole yard. Qiao answered with the actual task she had purchased: a source comparison, with paid handling elsewhere. The supplier could take an unresolved item back to the source or wait for the assigned contact. Lin did not defend herself by showing an application or touching the plate. He Song kept the complaint separate from the condition record. A moment of humiliation passed without rewriting either her clinical restriction or the object's evidence. The work continued through the arrangement the employer had accepted.

mine_p16_020.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_020.text: During the first scheduled rest Lin looked beyond the yard fence at the ordinary moth habitat. Rain had darkened the protected strip, and Jia's marked observation patch remained closed to wheel traffic. She could see only the near corner from her stool. It was tempting to convert that small sight into a report that the whole habitat was well. Instead she asked Ren to keep her observation local if anyone used it. The limit cost no wages. It made the spoken evidence fit the actual view, something she could still practice while every input route remained stopped.

mine_p16_021.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_021.text: The first four hours ended with one source question still open. Ren accepted it for the next assigned contact rather than keeping Lin at the table. She had performed the accepted oral role with rests, no writing, no carrying, and no input application. The employer paid four coppers after the completed turn. Twenty became twenty four again in her protected personal account. He Song received his own wage through his own roster. Lin thanked him for asking before correcting a sentence, and he thanked her for refusing to pretend he had been idle beside her.

mine_p16_022.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_022.text: At Han's room she wanted to describe the day as a return. Lei asked a return to what. The oral role had been real work, but it was not her former assistant shift and had not restored the stopped cultivation route. Lin admitted the difference mattered. She told him about the rubbed number, the carrier, and the refusal to remain after four hours. He said that sounded like a new job done properly. The answer felt less triumphant and more durable. Han overheard only the last words and asked whether a properly done job could include washing one's own bowl.

mine_p16_023.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_023.text: Lin followed the ordinary movement advice while handling her meal things and left any loaded task to its assigned person. There was no little secret hand exercise hidden under Han's joke. The room kept its familiar disagreements about salt, beans, and the closing window. Those arguments had survived the canopy, the clinic journeys, and her failed preparation without becoming proof that anyone was fully restored. She liked their stubborn everyday size. Mu arrived after a paid repair contact with a cracked buckle she had refused to replace without the right material, and they compared troublesome customers over supper.

mine_p16_024.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_024.text: Three days later rain forced the surface carriers to slow. The sheltered oral table remained outside the closed gallery and received only items accepted under the revised ordinary yard clearance. Ren brought fewer sheets and explained why. Lin had not seen the wet approaches beyond the gate. She could repeat the actual source report without certifying the entire mine sound. Qiao moved one receiving load to a later paid handler interval. Slowness had a cost, but nobody made Lin's wrist a reason to disguise the cost. Her narrow work would happen within the changed conditions rather than against them.

mine_p16_025.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_025.text: Day 611 brought the next personal board payment. Four coppers left the actual twenty four, and twenty remained before the second reduced turn. The paid period covered Days 611 through 617. Lin kept the board receipt with the work record because the two dates could be confused if she looked only at their matching numbers. Lei's own weekly housing charge had been paid separately on Day 605 and the next would be Day 612. Neither of them could solve the other's account by calling every meal a common kindness. They could share supper while retaining separate settled obligations.

mine_p16_026.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_026.text: Lei completed his second seated sorting half day on Day 611 and received the second four copper wage. His carrier noticed a damp paper sleeve and asked whether Lei would flatten it by force. Lei declined the grip and referred the condition to the source contact. The task had been sorting accepted sizes, not repairing defective stock. A delay belonged to the actual material. Lin heard the story after work, not from a view into his private workstation. She liked that he could now complain about an ordinary supplier instead of having every conversation begin with his missing fingers.

mine_p16_027.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_027.text: On Day 614 Lin's second oral turn brought a sharper dispute. A cart account showed a charge accepted for a journey that had been cancelled at the wet gate. The sender wanted the writer to copy the intended movement as performed because the carrier had been ready. Lin asked what actually departed. Ren obtained the authorized carrier answer: nothing had left under that entry. Readiness could have its contracted cost, but the receiving record could not claim the goods arrived. He Song separated the proposed readiness charge from the false journey, and the disagreement acquired a shape someone could address.

mine_p16_028.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_028.text: The sender accused Lin of being unkind to a carrier who needed the money. She asked for the accepted readiness term rather than denying that need. It proved to be a finite two copper charge, authorized independently of the unused journey price. The employer's account could settle that real obligation without inventing transport. Lin did not pay it from her medical reserve, nor tell the carrier what his household required. The corrected source answer satisfied neither angry person immediately. It let the actual charge survive while removing a story about goods that had never crossed the gate.

mine_p16_029.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_029.text: He Song read the correction back before filing it. Lin heard one word that made the readiness charge sound like a completed delivery and asked him to retain the precise distinction. He changed it openly and noted the source answer. The four hour turn ended at the accepted time, with Ren taking the remaining payment question through the proper account. Lin received the second four copper wage for her completed narrow work. Twenty became twenty four. She left without trying to carry the unresolved argument home as an unpaid extension of the task.

mine_p16_030.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_030.text: The ordinary evening walk felt less tiring than the first week, and she recorded that improvement for the next qualified review. It did not authorize an input rehearsal. At the practice court entrance Guan was resetting a bench for a different learner's accepted lesson. Lin watched from the public path until she noticed herself imagining the release she would perform better now. She moved on. Imagining a safe ending was not dangerous by itself, but she knew how quickly longing had once supplied a reason to attempt it. The stopped fixture remained stopped without needing another humiliating confrontation.

mine_p16_031.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_031.text: Mu asked whether avoiding the court made it harder to return later. Lin said she did not know. She was following the actual plan, not proving a theory of confidence. They spoke about Mu's screen work instead. A customer had finally hired the proper frame worker, and the resulting fit allowed Mu's ordinary cloth repair to hold. The earlier refusal had not cured the frame. It had kept the repair from carrying a task it could not perform. Lin liked the example because the customer had come back for a result, not to thank anyone for a moral lesson.

mine_p16_032.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_032.text: On Day 618 the next four copper board payment again reduced Lin's actual reserve to twenty. It covered the room and meals through Day 624. The floor was deliberate: the reduced wages arrived after each week's board obligation, and she had saved enough for that ordering. Han did not offer a fictional advance against a certificate or a future lab post. He accepted the actual payment and mentioned that the north window needed an ordinary hinge repair. Lin gave him the carpenter's contact without taking the hinge down herself. Knowledge could be useful without becoming an unauthorized loaded task.

mine_p16_033.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_033.text: Lei's third paid sorting turn also fell on Day 618. Its four hours included the agreed rests and the carrier's handling. A clerk praised his speed and suggested a second lot after the end. Lei declined the added unpaid work and sent the request to Qiao for a separate future arrangement. The eight week support account had bought specific turns, not every hour his hand could be persuaded to give. He received the third four copper wage and returned with the actual record. Lin recognized the temptation in the praise because she had once mistaken it for a clinical finding.

mine_p16_034.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_034.text: An apprentice arrived at the oral table on Day 621 with two incompatible accounts from his elders. One described a sound stair tread before the new weather; the other described later propagation at the excluded gallery edge. He wanted Lin to say which man had lied. She could not collapse the dates into one condition. The earlier checked tread could have been sound then, and the later restriction could have been necessary after change. She asked him to take both dated source statements to the structural contact. Neither her receiving role nor her failed bridge made her that examiner.

mine_p16_035.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_035.text: The third four hour oral turn on Day 621 handled those dated questions through Ren. He Song recorded what the apprentice had actually observed and kept the elders' reports attributed. Fan's authorized practical reply distinguished the locations and dates without disclosing a private witness account. Lin spoke the comparison within the employer's accepted task. No one reopened the excluded gallery because the paperwork had become clearer. At the end she received four coppers for the performed turn. Her reserve returned from twenty to twenty four, and the apprentice left with a narrower answer than an accusation.

mine_p16_036.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_036.text: Fan passed the public table later and asked whether Lin had any direct new observation from inside. She said no; her work had remained on the surface. He nodded and continued to the structural team. The brief exchange hurt more than she expected because once she had hoped being known would make people assume her knowledge reached everywhere. Now his question preserved the actual boundary. She could help distinguish source statements without acquiring a gallery view. The mine needed many kinds of competent work, and this week hers was a small sound part of that network.

mine_p16_037.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_037.text: At the lodging Mu and Lei argued about whether a person owed gratitude for suitable work. Lei said he was grateful for wages and furious about having to fight for ordinary limits. Mu thought both could be true. Lin offered the oral table's separate paid writer as an example of a practical answer that had required somebody else's labor. Han interrupted to ask whether gratitude could be kept away from the salt jar until supper was finished. They laughed, then returned to the argument. The ordinary room did not turn loss into an agreement everyone could comfortably share.

mine_p16_038.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_038.text: Lin's next board charge was paid on Day 625, four coppers before the fourth reduced wage was earned. The paid week ran through Day 631, and twenty remained in the actual protected reserve. Lei completed his fourth four hour sorting turn that day, receiving another four coppers from the separate employer support account. Their matching dates made the accounts easy to confuse. Lin kept her own receipt apart from his. The employer had paid his board on Day 619; her own payment purchased hers. No one used the shared room to move a clinical obligation between people.

mine_p16_039.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_039.text: The fourth oral receiving turn began on Day 628 in unusually warm weather. Qiao shortened a carrier's exposed route under the ordinary heat plan and kept the sheltered table supplied through another paid handler. Lin took the scheduled rests and the permitted water without extending her hours to compensate for the change. A supplier said the shade made her job easy. He Song asked him to wait while Ren obtained the actual condition source. Easy appearance did not make a disputed account resolve itself. Lin kept her voice calm, which was work enough for that interval.

mine_p16_040.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_040.text: The condition source corrected a packaging description before it entered the accepted receiving record. Lin had heard only a sender's first report, not inspected the cargo herself. She let the correction remain visible. He Song did not make her appear infallible by quietly removing the earlier attributed question. The completed four hour role ended with its limits intact, and she received the fourth four copper wage. Twenty became twenty four. On the short walk home she was tired but had followed the actual practical advice. She recorded that ordinary fatigue separately from any claim about usable input capacity.

mine_p16_041.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_041.text: Lei's second limited duty check occurred on Day 630. The employer's support account paid the other four copper clinical fee after the ordinary assessment. Chen considered what he had actually done, the viable hand's present function, and the continued exclusions, then kept the appropriate seated role within its existing limits. She did not offer finger restoration or unlimited carrying. The current paid housing week had begun on Day 626 and ran through Day 632. Lei chose to share the practical duty result with Qiao. He kept a private question about appearance out of the employer's file.

mine_p16_042.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_042.text: Lin heard that question only because Lei brought it to supper himself. He had asked whether a new work glove should disguise the gap or fit the viable hand comfortably. Chen had directed the ordinary fitting issue to the appropriate maker and left the personal preference to him. Lei wanted comfort and feared looking changed. Mu said she would notice either way because she knew him. The answer was not consoling in the way he expected, but it was honest. Han offered his old cloth scraps for an ordinary trial fitting, without claiming they were suitable before the maker checked.

mine_p16_043.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_043.text: The glove maker came during an agreed short contact outside Lei's paid shift. She examined the ordinary fitting need and explained what her proposed work could actually provide. Lei decided to wait until he had chosen the use he wanted. No charge was incurred for a glove not ordered, and no company fund was silently assigned to it. Lin saw him tolerate that unfinished decision better than she tolerated her own stopped route. He said choosing slowly was easier when nobody kept calling the choice proof of his courage. She apologized for having done that once.

mine_p16_044.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_044.text: The word once was too convenient. Lei named two earlier conversations in which she had praised his persistence while missing the strain he described. Lin listened. He was not accusing her of causing the canopy or asking for a remedy she could not provide. He wanted their friendship to have room for resentment as well as admiration. She admitted she had been using his composure to make the mine feel bearable. He looked relieved and angry at the same time. Supper cooled between them, and neither hurried to turn the difficult exchange into a reassuring conclusion.

mine_p16_045.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_045.text: Mu stayed for the ordinary meal and spoke about an unpaid customer who had called her patient because he liked not settling the account. She had required the actual payment before accepting another repair. Lei laughed, then asked whether patience was always someone's attempt to purchase labor cheaply. Lin said no, but the compliment did not settle an obligation. The conversation regained its rough familiar shape. They could disagree without using the missing hand or stopped route as an argument that ended every subject. Han warmed the beans and charged nobody for having been troublesome at his table.

mine_p16_046.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_046.text: The Day 632 board payment again took four coppers from Lin's actual twenty four, leaving twenty before the last reduced shift. It covered the room and meals through Day 638. Lei completed his fifth seated sorting turn that day and received his own fifth four copper wage. He had followed the qualified ordinary limits through five actual turns, not five promises. The next employer housing payment fell on Day 633. Lin noted the separate date and left his support money where it belonged. Their accounts had different purposes even when supper happened in the same room.

mine_p16_047.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_047.text: Qiao met Lin before the final oral turn and asked whether the arrangement should become a permanent way to ignore her recovery plan. Lin said no. The accepted five dates were finite; any later role would require the next advice and a new agreement. Qiao approved the answer and told Ren to keep the writer's current booking within those completed hours. A useful accommodation did not erase its costs or oblige someone to remain forever. Lin wanted more ordinary work eventually, but she would not promise a recovered capacity the next qualified review had not established.

mine_p16_048.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_048.text: The employer's housing account paid Lei's Day 633 board charge for the week through Day 639. Of the separate seventy two copper support account, fifty two had now been spent on six weekly board payments, the five performed sorting wages, and both qualified duty checks. Twenty remained for the three later four copper turns and two later four copper board weeks. That arithmetic bought no extra operation and restored no finger. Lei could see a finite supported period with an actual end. Qiao would discuss suitable ordinary employment before the covered period finished rather than disguising an endless promise.

mine_p16_049.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_049.text: Lin's fifth and final reduced oral turn began on Day 635. A sender brought a claim that a plate correction had been accepted in one of her earlier shifts and wanted it treated as universal approval for a new lot. He Song found the actual attributed record. It concerned one defined condition question on one receiving entry. Lin asked for the present lot's source and condition. The sender sighed but complied. Remembering her answer did not extend it beyond the task in which it had been earned. The new work needed its own ordinary evidence.

mine_p16_050.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_050.text: A carrier stepped toward Lin's stool with the plate to make the answer easier. She directed it to the assigned stand and waited for Ren's description instead. No handwriting, loaded grip, carrying, lifting, or qi application entered the turn. The scheduled rests stayed inside the four hours, and He Song kept the physical pages under his own paid task. Lin could see how many small moments were required to make the accepted accommodation real. The restriction was not a sentence she obeyed once at the clinic. It survived because people actually arranged the work around it.

mine_cash_reduced_closed_635.speaker: narrator
mine_cash_reduced_closed_635.text: The fifth four hour turn ended on time, with the remaining source question assigned to Ren. Lin received the final four copper reduced wage after completion. The five actual dates, 607, 614, 621, 628, and 635, had paid twenty in all; the board charges on Days 604, 611, 618, 625, and 632 had cost twenty. The protected reserve was twenty four after the final payment and had never fallen below twenty between those charges and wages. Earlier care remained paid. No future employment or private comparison fee had been spent before it was received.

mine_p16_052.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_052.text: He Song gave her the completed work record in the accepted oral reading form, handling the pages himself. She thanked him for the questions he had asked, especially the ones that had stopped a vague sentence entering the source account. He said those questions had been his work, and he was glad the role had been named. Ren offered to book another turn before the next review if Lin wanted it. Qiao stopped that suggestion until qualified advice and an actual new agreement. Lin appreciated Ren's wish to keep her useful without letting it quietly overrule the finite arrangement.

mine_exam_recovery.speaker: narrator
mine_exam_recovery.text: During the stopped period the ordinary wrist signs had improved under paid qualified care, restricted movement, suitable reduced work, and actual sleep. The Day 601 examination had supported the narrow duty trial; five completed turns through Day 635 had introduced none of the stated warning changes, and Lin had followed the practical limits rather than testing loaded grip. This was ordinary recovery in progress, with care and wages already performed and paid. It did not restore a demonstrated usable input route. The next tissue review and independent instrument work still needed their own findings before any revised preparation.

mine_p16_054.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_054.text: Lin left the receiving table with relief and a little grief. The reduced role had done what it promised. It had also taught her to be useful without occupying the center of every correction. He Song and Ren continued after her four hours under their own accepted work. She could hear their discussion fading as she crossed the sound yard. No private route had opened because she had worked honestly. Her current application remained stopped, and the six pair qualification remained historical. Yet the month was not empty; actual people had been paid for actual useful acts.

mine_p16_055.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_055.text: At Han's room she found a new list of ordinary hinge and roof repairs pinned beside the meal times. The carpenter, not Lin, had accepted the hinge work she referred. Han asked whether she would check his copied contact number aloud. She could do so within an ordinary brief conversation, using the actual source note he held, without taking over a paid repair task. She gave one correction and left the rest with him. The favor had an end. Learning to stop a useful answer was becoming as important in the room as it had been at the receiving table.

mine_p16_056.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_056.text: Mu arrived with the customer's frame now properly repaired by its accepted worker. Her cloth fit it, and the customer had settled both separate jobs. She did not pretend her first repair had carried the whole result. Lei said that was an uncommon way to tell a successful story. Mu replied that she wanted another worker to be paid when that worker's task had made success possible. Lin thought of He Song and the carriers, then of Wei's stop and Chen's tissue assessment. Her recovery had many actual hands around it. None supplied a magical result they had never performed.

mine_p16_057.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_057.text: Their evening argument concerned whether the mine should display the old warning bell near the public gate. Lei wanted it close enough to be heard in an actual emergency, not preserved as a memorial object whose rope could not be touched. Mu thought it could serve both uses if its ordinary inspection and actual sound path remained maintained. Lin had not inspected the bell and said so. They asked Ou at the next public contact rather than making their room's agreement into a safety decision. The old deaths deserved memory, and living people needed an alarm that actually worked.

mine_p16_058.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_058.text: Ou's authorized practical answer arrived on Day 636: the active bell would stay in its inspected position, and a separate permitted account of the older incident could be displayed without obstructing its rope or access. He had consulted the actual ordinary alarm responsibility, not taken Lin's opinion as an order. Lei approved the result grudgingly because he disliked the proposed memorial phrasing. The words could be discussed through their owners. Lin carried that distinction back to Han's room, hearing Shen's living refrain remembered by living workers while Lu Sen remained dead. No echo had answered the consultation.

mine_p16_059.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_059.text: Lin read her next appointment dates that evening, then closed the book. Day 642 would bring the qualified tissue review; Day 668 would bring the prepaid independent instrument and control review if the actual recovery allowed its work. Before them, ordinary employment would need actual accepted demands and appropriate clinical advice. She had no reason to invent hidden primary practice in the gap. The desire to catch up was strong enough to recognize by name now. She could let it sit beside the dates without making it a source of usable input or an authority to resume.

mine_p16_060.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_060.text: Lei asked whether she still wanted the small circuit. She said yes, more carefully than before. He asked whether wanting it made the last month worthless. She said no, then described the first oral source question and the paid writer's open correction. The answer was small enough for him to believe. He told her about refusing the extra sorting lot on Day 618. They were not competing in recovery. Each had found one actual way to keep an agreed limit under pressure, and neither way restored what had been lost. Wanting more could coexist with a completed useful month.

mine_p16_061.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_061.text: Han put the bowls away with the appropriate ordinary handling and announced that tomorrow's beans would be better because he had bought them from another seller. Mu demanded the actual source of that confidence. He named the seller, then admitted he had not tasted the new lot. Lin laughed until her eyes watered. No one asked her laughter to prove clinical recovery. The room's life continued within its paid weeks, with people willing to mock an bean claim and willing to go on eating together. She went to bed without an input attempt hidden after the lamp was out.

mine_p16_062.speaker: narrator
mine_p16_062.text: On the morning after the completed reduced roster, Lin took the sound path toward Qiao's public employment contact. She carried no load and had the practical advice available through its chosen source. The twenty four copper protected reserve remained actual, the next board week was already paid through Day 638, and later wages still required a new accepted arrangement and performance. She could discuss suitable ordinary work without presenting a stage seven certificate she did not have. The mine ahead was busy, damaged, and alive. Her stopped route would meet real checks in its proper time.
